name: Can wainscoting be installed over existing textured drywall?

mainEntity.name: Can wainscoting be installed over existing textured drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, wainscoting can be installed over textured drywall, but the texture dictates the construction technique. For styles like board-and-batten or picture framing where the wall serves as the recessed panel, heavy textures like knockdown or orange peel will show through. In those cases, a carpenter must skim-coat the lower drywall smooth or install thin hardboard backer sheets before applying the trim. Alternatively, full tongue-and-groove beadboard or flat shiplap panels completely cover the textured drywall, eliminating the need for extensive skimming.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. If the drywall texture shows inside panel frames, the wall must be skim-coated smooth or fitted with a thin backer sheet; full-coverage beadboard covers it completely.
